snippet.title: Eldor'idle - Official Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Eldor'idle, a clicker-idle RPG game developed by Nautlander. Players will smash pots, recruit gnomes, raid mines, unlock upgrades, and optimize everything for financial gain. Eldor'idle is coming soon to PC (Steam).
